description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -Yakkaduwa, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - (25/55039)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters for intestate properties, including specific parcel numbers, land extents, and cadastral details. It involves calling for claims to property and the process for registering land titles under the Registration of Title Act, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
